about: Staging JS for tools/uishots.ps1, one entry per screen of ui-screens.json. Each js is the body of an async function run on a FRESH page of the fixture (storage wiped, booted), with U = window.__uis (the prelude: wait, key, down, up, hold, click, on, el, closeModals, untitle, until, floor = title to welcome pack to the Undercroft floor, dep = deploy a kit, raid, near, modal). It returns nothing, or SKIP: why. expect is a JS predicate that must hold after staging or the screen is reported NOT STAGED. query is appended to the fixture URL. before is the prose recipe the before shots used.

screens.name: 21-raid-hud-calm
screens.screen: In-raid HUD calm, extraction-point banner, CONCEALED IN COVER

screens.name: 33-raid-fight-alerts
screens.screen: In-raid fight: THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU alert, LOCATION REVEALED, enemy name tags, HP 83
screens.before: remove .on from open modals, click #resumebtn; move the 3 nearest live G.ents to player+(220..340, -80..100), set alert=1,state='chase',seen=1; __say('LOCATION REVEALED'); wait 1.8 s
screens.js: U.dep({kit:['gun_carbine','medkit','bandage','bandage','plate','frag','smoke'],seed:4242,mapIx:0}); await U.wait(2500); var g=__state(), p=g.player; var L=U.near(g.ents.filter(function(e){ return e.hp>0; }),3); L.forEach(function(e,i){ e.x=p.x+220+i*60; e.y=p.y-80+i*90; e.alert=1; e.state='chase'; e.seen=1; }); __say('LOCATION REVEALED'); await U.wait(1800); return L.length+' moved, hp '+Math.round(p.hp);

screens.name: 34-raid-downed-pickups
screens.screen: DOWN state (self-revive timer, HP 0, damage number) plus the pickup stack and world loot labels
screens.before: same raid: __openFull() on the 3 nearest G.containers (throws after granting, harmless); the pillbox downed the player meanwhile; wait 1.5 s
screens.js: U.dep({kit:['gun_carbine','medkit','bandage','bandage','plate','frag','smoke'],seed:4242,mapIx:0}); await U.wait(2500); var g=__state(), p=g.player; U.near(g.containers,3).forEach(function(c){ try{ __openFull(c); }catch(e){} }); p.iv=0; p.hp=5; try{ __arm.hurt(40,'sentry','THE PILLBOX'); }catch(e){ return 'SKIP: hurt threw '+e; } await U.wait(1500); return 'downed '+p.downed+' hp '+p.hp;

screens.js: var want=["35.28","33.68","27.38","8.66","31.41","31.09","13.39","11.58","31.05","29.11","31.23","13.05","35.15","34.89","31.64","35.65","31.33","30.66","29.48","20.75","10.06","11.52","35.30","31.32","33.82"], L=window.__REGRESS.filter(function(t){ return want.indexOf(t.v)>=0; }), fail=[], skip=0, done=0, t0=performance.now(), i, r, t; try{ __runPrep(); }catch(_e){} for(i=0;i<L.length;i++){ if(performance.now()-t0>205000) break; t=L[i]; r=null; try{ __topClear(); __ctxHeal(); __pilLive(); r=t.run(); }catch(e){ r='threw: '+(e&&e.message||e); } done++; if(r&&String(r).indexOf('SKIP: ')===0) skip++; else if(r) fail.push('v'+t.v+': '+String(r).slice(0,420)); await new Promise(function(d){ setTimeout(d,0); }); } return 'UNJUDGED ran '+done+' of '+L.length+' (asked '+want.length+'), skipped '+skip+', failed '+fail.length+' | '+fail.join(' | ');
